description: This file contains the implementation of a custom image renderer for Markdown content within an HTML documentation generation system. It handles URL resolution for images, ensuring correct linking within the documentation, and supports configuration and XML rendering.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for handling image nodes in Markdown to ensure URLs are correctly resolved relative to the documentation structure, integrating with the Daux configuration system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with Daux configuration and sets up the parent renderer.

methods.name: getCleanUrl
methods.description: Resolves and cleans the image URL, handling external, data, and internal URLs, and throws if an internal link cannot be resolved in static mode.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node after cleaning its URL, delegating actual rendering to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the parent renderer.

methods.name: getXmlTagName
methods.description: Delegates retrieval of the XML tag name to the parent renderer.

methods.name: getXmlAttributes
methods.description: Delegates retrieval of XML attributes to the parent renderer.
